mappings.rationale: Explicitly labelled supplier ABN field. Semicolon-separated list of ABNs is split into one identifier per ABN; checksum validation via abn transform. Each ABN emitted as identifier-only party claim with no paired name or address. Source sample shows 88 of 94 non-empty values checksum-valid; values with spaces are normalised by the abn transform.
